abort_conditions: PREFLIGHT (before any Trn2 run): the resolved startup config/log must show local-conv enabled in the default model and the NKI local-conv path selected when --nki-local-conv is passed, and the compiled two-tap path selected in the control. If the flag resolves as already-on in the control, or local-conv is disabled by default, the experiment is a no-op: do not run, record as NOT-RUNNABLE.

PREFLIGHT: the controller environment lacks NKI_VENV_PATH (all fs NKI runs set NKI_VENV_PATH=/home/ubuntu/workspace/native_venv). If train.py at 9a4caa7b cannot dispatch the NKI kernel under the fixed controller environment (raises, or logs a fallback to the compiled conv), classify INVALID / NOT-RUNNABLE, not falsified; do not add env variables as part of this proposal.

INVALID (precedence 1): crash, non-finite loss at any logged step, causality_passed != true, no final checkpoint, git dirty, or any environment/launch difference from the same-host control other than the single flag (--num-steps 5000, --max-train-seconds 1800, --seed 42, CC exactly '--optlevel=1', LNC=2, nproc 4 must all match).

SMOKE GATE (300 s, same host as its control smoke): do not promote to full if smoke steps <= 335 (no throughput gain over 334/335) or if loss at matched step counts deviates from the control smoke by more than 0.02 nats in the same direction for the last 100 logged steps (kernel non-equivalence). Smoke steps in 336-344 promote only with a note that the predeclared +3% was missed.

FALSIFIED (precedence 2, valid full run): completed steps <= same-host control steps (2071 trn21 / 2076 trn22) — throughput prediction failed regardless of bpb — OR public_val_bpb >= control bpb - 0.001.
SUCCESS (precedence 3): valid full run with steps >= 1.05x same-host control steps AND public_val_bpb <= control bpb - 0.003.

INCONCLUSIVE (precedence 4, exhaustive remainder): valid full run with steps > control and bpb < control - 0.001 but failing either SUCCESS threshold; record, do not adopt, do not repeat without a new hypothesis.

Budget accounting: report training_seconds and startup allowance explicitly; if NKI kernel compilation is charged against the budget per README.md and cannot be separated, state that in the record rather than reinterpreting the step count.
